title: CamelBak Crux 2L Reservoir — product specifications
claims: The Crux 2L reservoir has a capacity of 2 L / 70 oz, a weight of 7 oz / 210 g, dimensions 38 x 19 x 6 cm, and a polyurethane material.
An on/off lever seals the drinking tube one-handed, and the big bite valve self-seals after each drink to reduce drips; the reservoir is Quick Link compatible.
Crux delivers 20% more water per sip than the prior design and has an ergonomic handle for refilling; the brand's lifetime guarantee covers reservoirs against manufacturing defects.
